Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses a model system of recombinant protein (TG2) and synthetic peptides (PepQ, P1, P2, P3) to simulate Celiac disease pathogenesis. The primary variable is the addition of these peptides to the enzyme. Molar ratios are used as a dose-response axis to determine preferred binding sites. Mapping to 'chemical_or_drug' is used as the peptides are synthetic exogenous agents used to perturb the protein state, though they are biologically ligands; however, they are treated as synthetic model reagents here.
